# Six Hats Review

> Template: §20.7 — Edward de Bono's method for change analysis

## White Hat — Facts
- <!-- Known facts, evidence, data, inputs -->

## Red Hat — Intuition / Emotional Signals
- <!-- Gut feelings, concerns, team anxiety, owner instincts -->

## Black Hat — Risks / Failure Points
- <!-- What can go wrong, vulnerabilities, hidden destroyers -->

## Yellow Hat — Benefits / Positive Potential
- <!-- Value gained, product/process improvements -->

## Green Hat — Alternatives / Better Options
- <!-- Other approaches, workarounds, stronger solutions -->

## Blue Hat — Management Conclusion
- Next step:
- Escalate or not:
- Ready for routing:
